propositions: write-side temp-file faults (unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file) are not retried by run_git_write because transient retry covers only read-side signatures
the identical write-side fault class is already recognized and retried in event_append._git_add, creating asymmetry where store self-heals in one path and fails in others

moving the write-side marker family from event_append into the shared gitutil seam creates one definition that all run_git_write callers inherit, unifying retry behavior across s3_doctor, compaction, and claim/transition writers

the nested retry composition in event_append's commit paths inadvertently provided 3x3 attempts; consolidating to a single _with_transient_fault_retry restores the intended bounded 3-attempt budget matching read-side faults
